notes: The with him of the compound συνετάφημεν goes to the expressed dative αὐτῷ under rule 106's oblique arm, the ASV having written buried as an English verb word of its own for the compound; 6:8 reads συζήσομεν the same way, and 6:6 keeps with him inside the verb only because no dative stands there.
οὕτως … καί splits into so and also under rule 100, the ASV writing no even here.
